ownership: One atomically claimed persistent bootstrap; one 7424-byte PSRAM payload allocation; no internal fallback or live reset/free/realloc; allocation/timer/task failures sticky
Four bounded slots; producer reserves WRITING under mux, copies outside mux, rechecks generation/epoch at commit; consumer owns PENDING slot under same mux; timer/OFF never recycle SDK-owned slot
CTRL and lifecycle have dedicated slots; accepted SDK job remains on persistent owner stack; late SDK return may release its held payload only after actual API return
OFF changes output gate and epochs, supersedes only active pending request once; physical resources/radio remain unknown; late completion cannot apply superseded request or unquarantine
Application event handler records station event only; SDK default event handlers remain vendor-managed
BeginSdk atomically rechecks job/link epoch before entry; TX completion counters mean actual complete sendto return, not local admission or peer delivery
lock_order: Owner mux protects POD metadata only. SDK/lwIP, payload memcpy and callbacks run outside it. Transport completion callback takes Transport stats mux only after owner mux release. Watchdog only observes/latches; no notify, logging, SDK, allocation or reclamation.

deadline_semantics.qualification: Application isolation deadlines; no cancellation/driver completion claim. Queue TTL forbids starting stale datagram; pending slots need not reclaim within 1s under continuous priority traffic or quarantined owner. SDK never-return keeps owner/slot/socket alive.
